sources.title: wd-swinv2-tagger-v3: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview wd-swinv2-tagger-v3 is an image tagging model that assigns ratings, character tags, and general descriptive tags to images. Built and maintained by SmilingWolf, this model uses the SwinV2 transformer architecture trained on over 7 million Danbooru images using JAX and TPU resources from Google's TRC program. The model achieves a macro F1 score of 0.4541 at a precision-recall threshold ...

sources.snippet: Runs SmilingWolf's wd-vit-tagger-v3 locally with CUDA + ONNX and a Gradio UI. Two output modes: embed tags directly into image metadata (great for Eagle or digiKam galleries) or output .txt sidecar files (for training).
